description: Show who this connection is signed in as: the email address, the assistant or token that acts for them, what it may do, and when the sign-in expires. The token value itself is never shown.
name: get_auth_status

client.description: Name of the connected assistant or token.

email.description: Email address of the signed-in person.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the connection expires, when known.

title: Get auth status
